name: Burning Blessing: Maximal Ferocity
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Pyro Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
After you trigger a Burning reaction: Your Burning Flame gains +1 Usage.
After you play a card whose Current Elemental Dice Cost is 0: Immediately trigger the End Phase effect of your Burning Flame. (Twice per Round)
